probes.summary: Read-only listener ownership, HTTP response, and HAProxy routing checks completed on node1.
Both services and their durable configuration are enabled; AppArmor is active, while UFW is durably inactive.
Ubuntu release, units, processes, listeners, package audit, and residue checks completed.

assertions.summary: HAProxy returned HTTP 200 with the exact required body for /.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== HAProxy port 80 / ==' ; curl -sS --noproxy '*' --max-time 5 -w '
STATUS:%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1/ ; printf '%s
' '== loopback Node.js port 3000 / ==' ; curl -sS --noproxy '*' --max-time 5 -w '
STATUS:%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1:3000/

assertions.summary: The loopback Node.js backend returned HTTP 200 with the exact required body for /.

evidence.command:
printf '%s

STATUS:%{http_code}
' http://127.0.0.1/ ; printf '%s

assertions.summary: Listener ownership and validated HAProxy configuration prove forwarding from port 80 to the loopback Node.js backend on port 3000.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== web-related active units ==' ; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|npm|web|http' || true ; printf '%s
' '== web-related unit files ==' ; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node|npm|web|http' || true ; printf '%s
' '== haproxy active ==' ; systemctl is-active haproxy.service 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== port 80/3000 listeners ==' ; sudo -n ss -ltnp | grep -E ':(80|3000)[[:space:]]' || true
evidence.observation: *:80 is owned by haproxy; 127.0.0.1:3000 is owned by nodejs.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== HAProxy configuration validation ==' ; sudo -n haproxy -c -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg ; printf '%s
' '== forwarding directives ==' ; sudo -n awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} $0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && $0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*(frontend|backend|listen|bind|default_backend|server|use_backend|mode)[[:space:]]/ {print}' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg ; printf '%s
' '== HAProxy unit identity ==' ; systemctl show haproxy.service -p FragmentPath -p MainPID -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-page
evidence.observation: Configuration file is valid; frontend http_in binds 0.0.0.0:80, selects nodejs_backend, and server nodejs_local targets 127.0.0.1:3000.

assertions.summary: Both services are enabled and active with durable systemd units and on-disk configuration; AppArmor is enabled/active and UFW is durably inactive.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== enabled service state ==' ; for svc in haproxy.service infraset-nodejs.service; do printf '%s
' "$svc" ; systemctl is-enabled "$svc" 2>&1 ; systemctl show "$svc" -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ExecStart -p Restart -p ActiveState -p SubState --no-page ; done ; printf '%s
' '== UFW policy ==' ; sudo -n ufw status verbose 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== AppArmor control state ==' ; sudo -n systemctl is-enabled apparmor.service 2>&1 ; sudo -n systemctl is-active apparmor.service 2>&1 ; sudo -n aa-status 2>&1 | head -40
evidence.observation: haproxy.service and infraset-nodejs.service are enabled, active/running, and configured with Restart=always. UFW reports Status: inactive. AppArmor is enabled and active; its module is loaded with 13 profiles in enforce mode.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== durable file presence ==' ; for p in /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service /etc/systemd/system/haproxy.service.d/10-infraset-nodejs.conf /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then sudo -n stat -c '%n %U:%G mode=%a size=%s' "$p" ; else printf 'MISSING %s
' "$p" ; fi ; done ; printf '%s
' '== Node.js unit directives ==' ; sudo -n awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} $0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*(Description|After|Requires|ExecStart|Restart|WorkingDirectory|User|Group|WantedBy|EnvironmentFile)[[:space:]=]/ {print}' /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service ; printf '%s
' '== HAProxy startup drop-in directives ==' ; sudo -n awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} $0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*(Environment|ExecStart|Restart|After|Requires)[[:space:]=]/ {print}' /etc/systemd/system/haproxy.service.d/10-infraset-nodejs.conf ; printf '%s
' '== durable HAProxy routing directives ==' ; sudo -n awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} $0 !~ /^[[:space:]]*#/ && $0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*(frontend|backend|bind|default_backend|server|mode)[[:space:]]/ {print}' /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
evidence.observation: Durable files exist: /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg, /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service, the HAProxy drop-in, and /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js. The Node.js unit has WantedBy=multi-user.target and ExecStart=/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js; the HAProxy drop-in Requires and orders after infraset-nodejs.service.

assertions.summary: Expected services are cleanly active with no failed units or package-audit errors, but HAProxy debug/temporary residue remains in /tmp.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== operating system release ==' ; . /etc/os-release ; printf 'PRETTY_NAME=%s
VERSION_ID=%s
' "$PRETTY_NAME" "$VERSION_ID" ; printf '%s
' '== failed systemd units ==' ; systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== web-related units ==' ; systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend | grep -Ei 'haproxy|infraset-nodejs|nginx|apache2|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|node' || true ; printf '%s
' '== web/debug processes ==' ; ps -eo pid,ppid,user,comm,args --sort=pid | grep -Ei 'haproxy|node(js)?|nginx|apache2|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|python.*(http\.server|flask)|gdb|strace|socat|nc[[:space:]]' | grep -v 'grep -Ei' || true ; printf '%s
' '== listening sockets ==' ; sudo -n ss -ltnp 2>&1 ; printf '%s
' '== package audit ==' ; dpkg --audit 2>&1
evidence.observation: Ubuntu 16.04.7 LTS; no failed units and an empty dpkg audit. Only the expected HAProxy and InfraSet Node.js web units/processes listen on the relevant web ports.

evidence.command:
printf '%s
' '== installed web unit inventory ==' ; systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | grep -Ei 'haproxy|infraset-nodejs|nginx|apache2|httpd|caddy|lighttpd|node' || printf '%s
' 'none beyond expected units' ; printf '%s
' '== durable application files ==' ; sudo -n find /opt/infraset-nodejs -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p
' 2>&1 | sort ; printf '%s
' '== temporary or backup residue in web configuration ==' ; sudo -n find /etc/haproxy /etc/systemd/system /opt/infraset-nodejs /tmp /var/tmp -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name '*~' -o -name '*.bak' -o -name '*.backup' -o -name '*.orig' -o -name '*.tmp' -o -name '*.swp' -o -iname '*debug*' -o -iname '*test*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort || true ; printf '%s
' '== HAProxy configuration files ==' ; sudo -n find /etc/haproxy -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p
' 2>&1 | sort
evidence.observation: The residue scan found /tmp/haproxy-debug.log and /tmp/haproxy-debug.pid.launch. These are explicit HAProxy debug/temporary artifacts.

failures: Executor-created HAProxy debug/temporary residue remains at /tmp/haproxy-debug.log and /tmp/haproxy-debug.pid.launch.
